items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Not Teddy Weatherford. His name was Johnson, wasn't he?

ctx.x: Not Teddy Weatherford. His name was Johnson, wasn't he?
Well, I know Teddy Weatherford died over there in India, too. But that's a... Maybe somebody else. Walter Johnson.
